_meta.author: Mistral Vibe (mistral-vibe)
_meta.purpose: Pilot taxonomy for the humanoid facet (LIBRARY.md Phases 1 and 4): re-classify the 215 existing image descriptions against a multi-question facet set, producing a first review queue.
design_notes: Entity type and representation are separate facets: a statue of a human is a depiction of a human, not a third kind of entity. The 215-image run showed the ambiguity lives at exactly this boundary.
primary_subject includes 'multiple' because some images contain both a human and a robot (Buck and Twiki); a single-label taxonomy without it forces a wrong answer.
contains_human reuses the exact criteria from classify_images.py so the pilot doubles as a consistency check against the original run.
All questions use the proven Choice schema (yes/no as two criteria) rather than guessing the Noul wire format; one call carries all five questions in a single parallel pass.

contains_human.instructions: Does this image contain a human?

criteria.yes: The image contains one or more humans (people, faces, bodies)

contains_robot.instructions: Does this image contain a robot or mechanical automaton?

criteria.yes: The image contains one or more robots: mechanical automatons, clearly manufactured machines with a body or face, whether photographed, illustrated, or rendered
criteria.no: The image contains no robots or mechanical automatons

contains_android.instructions: Does this image contain an android: an artificial being that passes as human?

criteria.yes: The image contains one or more androids: artificial beings manufactured to pass as human, where the image or its context identifies them as artificial (e.g., labeled as AI, synthetic, or android)
criteria.no: The image contains no androids: no artificial beings presented as human-passing

primary_subject.instructions: What is the primary humanoid subject of the image?

criteria.human: The main subject is one or more humans
criteria.robot: The main subject is one or more robots or mechanical automatons
criteria.android: The main subject is one or more androids: artificial beings that pass as human
criteria.multiple: The image prominently contains more than one distinct kind of humanoid (e.g., a human together with a robot)
criteria.none: The image contains no humanoid subject of any kind

criteria.photograph: A photograph of a real scene: actual people, objects, or places captured by a camera
criteria.illustration: A drawing, cartoon, comic, painting, or digital illustration
criteria.statue_or_render: A statue, figurine, sculpture, model, or 3D render of a subject
criteria.text_screenshot: A screenshot or scan of text: the image shows words or code, not a scene
criteria.other: None of the above: a diagram, chart, map, abstract image, or interface screenshot without a depicted subject
